content: First, the tokens of the $I$ are converted to embeddings and are fed one-by-one to the encoder, a single bi-LSTM layer, which encodes the tokens in $I$ into a sequence of hidden states - $H=encoder(I)$, where $ H=[h_1...h_P]$.
